_model: Consumption lives on three planes and they are not interchangeable. `billed` is extra-usage credits — real money, and the only plane that raises alerts. `plan` is how full a subscription window is: it tells you when you will be throttled, never what you will pay. `estimate` is what the same tokens would cost at list price — a comparison figure. Every profile is a subscription that may also spend credits; the plane belongs to the metric, not to the profile.

_metrics.billed.today: credits spent today, delta between two samples (account currency)
_metrics.billed.month.percent: percentage of the monthly cap consumed
_metrics.plan.<kind>.percent: how full a subscription window is (session, weekly, weekly_all, weekly_scoped)

_notify: Billed metrics notify by default. Plan and estimate metrics stay silent unless a rule sets "notify": true — that is what keeps window thresholds from firing every single day.
_cap: "cap" per profile overrides the reported monthly ceiling, so you can be warned well before the real limit.
